sam: Quick heads-up — I ran a RoPE sensitivity matrix for mixtral-8b comparing linear / NTK / YARN across longctx ranges (4k, 8k, 12k, 16k, 24k). Seeing an unexpected perplexity cliff for NTK between 8k -> 12k, while linear stays relatively flat. Also noticing a latency spike when the runtime picks the 32k padded kernel for sequences just over 8k. attaching short snippets below. :thinking:

jess: :eyes: can you paste the exact profile + kernel-selection trace? curious which kernel we fell into and why the fallback happened near 8k.

sam: paste of the command I ran:
```bash
./profile_inference --model mixtral-8b --rope ntk --seq-len 12288 --batch 1 --kernel-trace=1 --kv-stats=1
```
partial kernel trace:
```
[12:02:01] selected_kernel: geom_kern_v2 seq_opt=8192 best_cost=0.87
[12:02:01] fallback: pad_32k_kernel seq_len=12288 reason=quantized-tile-mismatch
[12:02:01] execute pad_32k_kernel latency_ms=148.3 tokens/sec=36
[12:02:01] kv_cache_bytes=1.34G
```
perplexity sample:
```
seq=8192 rope=ntk ppl=12.3
seq=12288 rope=ntk ppl=27.9  <-- cliff
seq=12288 rope=linear ppl=13.1
```
I re-ran on the same host but forced the kernel to geom_kern_v2 and perplexity cliff still present (so appears model/rope interaction > kernel-only).

linh: FYI I profiled KV behavior during the runs. Observed async eviction/compaction cycles that line up with the latency spikes. snippet:
```
[12:01:58] KV_CACHE_ENTRIES=450000
[12:02:00] KV_CACHE_BYTES 1.10G -> 1.98G (growth)
[12:02:01] KV_COMPACTION start
[12:02:01] GC_PAUSE 118ms
```
That GC pause correlates with the pad_32k_kernel exec. Likely the padded kernel increases per-layer working set so eviction thrashes.

matt: Two quick thoughts:
1) Kernel routing threshold looks too coarse. We currently pick pad_32k at round(seq/8192) logic; if seq is just over 8192 we should prefer a tiled kernel that handles mid-range without full pad. Proposed config tweak (canary):
```json
{"kernel_routing": {"use_padded_threshold": 16384, "prefer_tiled_for_range": [8193, 16383], "tiled_kernel": "geom_kern_v2"}}
```
2) Add KV soft-limit per-request that favors streaming eviction instead of synchronous compaction when seq spikes. This should reduce GC pauses at cost of slightly higher memory.

anya: ran cross-model quick checks to build per-model safe ranges (local cluster):
- mixtral-8b: NTK unsafe > ~10k (ppl cliffs start at 12k), linear safe to ~16k
- mistral-7b: NTK and linear both stable to ~14k, but YARN shows mild drift after 16k
- qwen-7b: linear safe to 16k, NTK safe to ~10k (similar pattern to mixtral)
So we should treat NTK variants as having a lower "safe" context ceiling on several models. I'll push a small CSV with numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

dev-bot: canary-deploy triggered for branch rope-routing-fix on cluster-canary-3 by matt at 1978888000 — tests queued (latency, kv-gc, perplexity regression).

sam: OK actionable summary:
- apply matt's kernel_routing canary and run the same NTK 12k test (target: avoid pad_32k_kernel).
- add KV soft-limit for the canary to reduce compaction stalls.
- add per-model safe ranges to model catalog (mixtral: NTK max 10k, linear 16k; qwen: NTK 10k, linear 16k; mistral: both 14k).
- run evals: perplexity sweep + quality eval (held-out prompts) vs baseline.
Anyone want to own the perf runs and the model catalog update?

jess: I'll own the perf runs and baseline diffs. Will run on canary-3 and send a short report.

linh: I'll implement KV soft-limit toggle and add logging for async compaction to get finer timelines.

matt: I'll push the kernel routing PR and monitor the canary. If latency stays stable for 12h we can promote.

anya: I'll consolidate the per-model safe ranges and open a tiny doc for product to consume (so feature flags can default to safe ranges).

sam: awesome. If perf runs still show perplexity cliffs after these infra changes, we need to run an isolated model re-eval with different RoPE exponent schedules (NTK hyperparams) — assign to research. :mag_right:
